name: ranged_open_fire
about: Ranged attack from the open. A hostile Troika gunman whose hint_groups admits no arena hint (FValidateHintType 0x10295c20 refuses on hint group AND m_iHintGroups == 0; the arena's nodes are group 1, the gunman's mask is group 2 only) sees the player in range. After SCHED_TROIKA_START_COMBAT 0xea (NEW_ENEMY), CNPC_VHumanCombatant's weapon split (0x103872d0) takes slot 605 CNPC_VHuman::SelectScheduleRangedCombat 0x10386560: no shoot-at hint, no 0x08/0x3c, the helpers answer 0 (the cover chooser finds no hint), and the split (neither 0x5f nor 0x08, not occluded, no 0x2e, not TOO_FAR) answers 0; CAI_BaseNPCTroika::SelectSchedule 0x102af660's combat ladder then takes CAN_RANGE_ATTACK1 (0x4f): 0x101e3f50, or RandomInt < 0x14 with no hint node and m_flEnemyDist < 800 -> 0xef SCHED_TROIKA_STEP_BACK_RANGE_ATTACK1, else 0xed SCHED_TROIKA_RANGE_ATTACK1 (cai_basenpctroika/sched_troika_range_attack1.sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE IGNORE_FAILURE, STOP_MOVING, RESOLVE_BOTCH, FACE_ENEMY, ANNOUNCE_ATTACK 1, TASK_RANGE_ATTACK1, WAIT_FINISH_SET 0.0, WAIT_FINISH_ADD_RANDOM 1.0, RESOLVE_BOTCH, WAIT_ATTACK_TIME1). TASK_RANGE_ATTACK1 plays the weapon's attack activity and its anim event fires the shot (HandleAnimEvent 0x10274e30 through DispatchAnimEvents 0x10091880); the task completes on IsActivityFinished; TASK_WAIT_ATTACK_TIME1 (StartTask 0x102a337d: m_flWaitFinished = the weapon's next-attack stamp 0x10252450 + 0x102c5730; complete only once that is <= curtime) holds until the weapon's next-attack time (item_w_thirtyeight.txt Attack_Rate .8 at range 0, NPC_Attack_Rate_Min/Max 1.0 / 2.5 at NPC_Attack_Rate_Base_Range 120, scaled up with range: ~387 units here), and the stamp is the shot's own write: CWeaponRanged::Shot 0x102387b0 (0x1023891b..0x1023895d) leaves +0x730 = max(old, curtime - frametime) + n x Attack_Rate, so a shot at T leaves T - frametime + 0.8 and 0x102c5730's draw at ~387 units adds 0.36..3.05 s: every wait ends 1.14..3.84 s after its shot (stories/v4/packets-S11.md items 2.3, 2.4). The first shot event is at 0.5 s, so the first wait completes no earlier than 0.5 + 1.14 = 1.64 s; each wait starts when TASK_RANGE_ATTACK1 completes, 0.5 s after its shot, and so holds at least 0.64 s. The player faces the gunman, so the gunman is inside the player's view cone and COND_BEHIND_ENEMY 0x57 is never set. The next selection fires again.
notes: Green since V4o (lane O3): the unstaged 3031 is the shot and Shot 0x102387b0 writes the next-attack stamp, so every wait holds. The first wait is pinned absolutely (until 1.6, retail 1.64 s) and the first two relatively (`after` waits / waits_again, `within` 0.5: a wait starts 0.5 s after its shot and cannot end before 1.14 s after it). Corrected by the V4a seam (J7, J6): `shot_event` matched any animevent; it is the attack clip's 3031 (smith_attack authors 3031 at cycle 0), through CWeaponRanged's operator 0x10238160 -> 0x10238320 -> ModeDispatch(1) 0x102383b0 -> slot 373 Shot 0x102387b0: no retail path fires a Troika human's shot without the event. The `never` damage on the player states that no shot lands before the event: the schema has no window that closes at a label, so it closes at 0.3 s, the earliest instant retail's first shot event can fall (START_COMBAT's TASK_WAIT_FACE_ENEMY 0.2 s, then a selection and the attack program's first think). V4c stages retail unkillable like sustained_fire: death after seven .38 packets otherwise makes BestEnemy 0x10274475 correctly drop the player and exit Combat. The timing and event assertions are unchanged.
